notes: This page is a picture, not a list: pick AUTO (Case Auto) or M (Case Manual) on the left, then adjust the settings shown for it. Row numbers here follow the manual's callouts.
Only this management page exists until you add your own My Menu tabs. Each tab you add becomes another page here.

shooting-info-disp.fw: Firmware 1.1.0 lets you set the grid display during movie recording too.

af-for-close-up-demos.fw: Firmware 1.1.0 makes this available in Creative Zone movie modes, not only the dedicated scene mode.

connect-to-wireless-remote.fw: Firmware 1.1.0 adds support for the BR-E2 wireless remote.

advanced-connection.fw: Firmware 1.1.0 adds support for the EDSDK/CCAPI developer kits.
